Cosmere.Scadrial.Def.AllomanticAbilityDe.label: compound steel
Cosmere.Scadrial.Def.AllomanticAbilityDe.description: Steel compounding grinds the world to a crawl. Muscles resist motion, limbs feel heavy, and each step takes effort — but every second, speed floods into the metalmind. With patience and pain, the Allomancer becomes a storm waiting to be unleashed.
